# M-Monogram

> Elite G900 customization atelier in Dubai. Bespoke Maybach and Brabus modifications for the Mercedes G-Class, plus a curated catalog of exterior, interior, and forged-wheel commissions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Studio overview, featured transformations, and contact.
- [Brand](/brand): The M-Monogram story, design pillars, and atelier philosophy.
- [Projects](/projects): Curated gallery of flagship G-Class transformations.
- [Modifications](/modifications): Catalog of exterior, interior, and forged-wheel commission services.
- [VIN Verification](/verify): Verify the authenticity of an M-Monogram build.
- [Press](/press): Press features and atelier updates.
- [Contact](/contact): Book a consultation with the Dubai atelier.
